title: Fix image scp from inaccessible or deleted working directories
body:
Fixes #24247

Problem:
When image scp transfers an image between local users, the save, load, and tag subprocesses inherit the caller's working directory. Running the transfer from a directory such as /root can fail because the destination user cannot access that directory during rootless initialization.

Fix:
Use the caller's physical directory to preserve relative paths and avoid inaccessible symlinks in PWD. Use / if Getwd returns ENOENT and return the other working-directory errors.

If subprocess startup fails with a permission error, retry once from /. Restrict the retry to fork/exec errors so a Podman command that has already started is never executed a second time. For the retry, create a fresh command with the same credentials, environment, and output handling.

Tests:
Extend the transfer test to use an inaccessible directory. Run its sudo checks from /.

Added coverage for relative and absolute configuration paths, transfers and tagging from a deleted directory, preserved image IDs, and missing-image errors.
